plan: With a private value of $20, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since this is a first-price sealed bid auction with payment at second-highest price, I want to bid strategically. My optimal strategy is to bid close to, but slightly below my true value. I'll bid $19.9 to capture almost the full potential gain while leaving a small margin of safety in case of close competing bids.

With a private value of $31, I want to maximize my potential profit. Since values are drawn independently and randomly between $0-$20, my high value suggests I should bid strategically. I'll aim to bid just above the likely maximum of other bidders. A bid around $20-$22 seems optimal - high enough to likely win, but not so high that I risk losing money if others bid low. This protects my substantial potential gain of $31.

With a private value of $12, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since the winner pays the second-highest bid, I want to bid strategically. A good approach is to bid slightly above my value to increase winning chances while ensuring positive expected gain. Given the $0-$20 range, I'll bid around $11.50 - this gives me a buffer to potentially win while still maintaining profit if I secure the item.
